description: Delivery context registry: max pixel boxes and default variant names for visual assets. Optimizers and PHP resolvers read this instead of ad-hoc magic numbers.

thumb.notes: Playlist rows, cover-flow, admin thumbs (~150 CSS px)

card.notes: Player flip cover / optimal; lightbox shares card in v0.8

huge.notes: Fullscreen HDTV bounding box; contain without cropping, stretching, or upscaling

logo.notes: Player header logo (~320px CSS + 2x retina); prefer alpha-preserving PNG/WebP

lightbox.notes: Deferred dedicated variant; currently aliases card

standard-stream.notes: Browser-safe MP4 stream; dimensions follow source (even scale)

thumb.where: Playlist row .playlist-track-cover, cover-flow, bio track list

share.where: makeSocial.py OG Facebook/Twitter crops (site link previews)
share.notes: Shipped: facebook/twitter 1200x630 from brand poster master. Deferred (do not generate until v2+ API publish): instagram_feed 1080x1350 (4:5), instagram_square 1080x1080 (1:1), instagram_stories_reels / tiktok 1080x1920 (9:16). Native posts are API-created, not site share buttons.
